subject: Obtain processed user input from lavaan object without estimating model

messages.author: 5adfa044990b7df7
messages.subject: Obtain processed user input from lavaan object without estimating model
parts:
Hello lavaan team,

I'm working on an R package, and I'm trying to leverage lavaan's infrastructure.

Ideally, I would like to pass the model syntax and data inputs to lavaan (relying on lavaan for data validation), then retrieve some objects from lavaan, mostly from lavInspect and SampleStats slot in the lavaan object. But I don't need lavaan to fit the models.

Is there a way to do this? Problem is some of the models may take a while to run, and I would like to drop the runtime.

If there is no way to do this, is there a combination of options that should speed up model estimation, e.g. I see setting `se = "none"` and `test = "none"` lead to a drop in runtime.

Thanks a lot for any help/advice you can offer,
James.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Obtain processed user input from lavaan object without estimating model
parts: You can set do.fit=FALSE. See the ?lavOptions help page.
